summary: Pakistani organizations should prioritize patching critical vulnerabilities, particularly CVE-2026-20349 and CVE-2026-68820, which are being actively exploited and have been added to the CISA KEV catalog, affecting multiple vendors including Microsoft and Adobe. The Pakistan CERT/NCCS has also issued alerts for PKCERT-71DA9F40 and PKCERT-E48A22A6, which target local organizations, and it is essential to apply the recommended mitigations to prevent potential attacks. To minimize the risk of zero-day exploits, such as CVE-2026-72898 and CVE-2026-8037, organizations should ensure their systems and software are up-to-date, and implement additional security measures, including network segmentation and intrusion detection systems.
